triggerReason: The autonomy lab had all control-plane capabilities but needed an explicit, machine-audited definition of verified action evidence and reproducible release thresholds.
action: Added replay and rollback metadata to accepted actions, three public versioned scenarios, a canonical readiness audit, a Verification view/API, extension contracts, and mobile Observer/Verification accessibility gates.
outcome: NEXUS-7 now meets its v1 north-star thresholds and exposes the supporting scenario results, fingerprints, evidence requirements, and extension boundaries to humans and machines.
evidence: Three scenarios replay twice for 250 ticks each with canonical equality
Verified autonomy loop rate meets or exceeds 90%
Deterministic replay success meets or exceeds 99%
Accepted actions reach 100% causal trace completeness and rollback coverage
Every scenario finishes with zero invariant violations
Observer and Verification pass mobile WCAG A/AA regression
Agent, ModelProvider, Scenario, and Repository extension contracts are documented
